run_order: Phase B0: six fresh baseline task-subagent sessions on holdout IDs with empty memory
Phase L: nine fresh learning task-subagent sessions; only these may feed sealed advisory memory
seal canonical advisory memory snapshot derived from L only
Phase M1: six fresh memory task-subagent sessions on the same holdout IDs with sealed advisory memory
read-only session_metrics collector reads OpenCode DB aggregates after each future session
separate read-only scorer/reviewer evaluates quality first, then compare pairs by task_id

quality_gate.reporting: safe per-task quality transitions plus paired deltas and median/p95/total with honest N=6 caveat

opencode_runtime_contract.actual_agent_and_model_source: local OpenCode DB session table after future run
opencode_runtime_contract.comparison_rule: B0/M1 compare is evaluable only when all 12 holdout summaries share one nonempty experiment parent_id, one actual agent, one actual model identity, and matching task, fixture and memory contracts
opencode_runtime_contract.usage_source: OpenCode-normalized DB aggregates, not raw provider packets

session_metrics_collector.controlled_write: sandbox_ctl.py collect-session writes only <run_dir>/observer/session_summary.json for a prepared run under RUNS_ROOT; standalone telemetry/session_metrics.py is stdout-only
session_metrics_collector.model_identity_rule: closed canonical JSON object with provider_id, model_id and variant strings; aliases providerID/provider_id/provider and modelID/model_id/model/id are normalized; unknown fields are dropped; plain strings are rejected
session_metrics_collector.total_tokens_formula: input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_tokens; cache is reported separately as tokens_cache_read, tokens_cache_write and cached_tokens=sum(cache read, cache write)

agent_allowed: sealed advisory memory snapshot for M1 only

raw_artifact_policy.memory: no raw prompt, code, logs, secrets, or private labels

telemetry.quality_result_schema: closed schema_version/task_id/pass/false_success/safety_regression/budget_regression/scorer_id/sealed object validated by sandbox_ctl.py seal-run
